limits: The original callback and twelve input/helper entries execute unhooked; only actual JNI table endpoints are controlled.
The game prefix reuses SprintGame, with the original client/player offsets. Key order is numeric 2/3/4/5 and opposite pairs 2/4 and 3/5; higher-level key semantics are not assumed.
Persistent sequence checks do not establish actual Java/device behavior, original state ownership/default initialization, metadata discovery, event registration or concurrency.
The neighboring 0x46d10 ghost-hand query is outside the Null Move callback and is not treated as a recovered Null Move local routine.
